Hiring: Generative AI/NLP Engineer (Python)




Location: Chennai
Experience: 5+ Years




We are looking for Immediate Joiners with strong expertise in Generative AI, NLP, and Python to build next-generation AI-powered solutions for enterprise eCommerce platforms.




Required Skills:

Python (5+ Years)
Generative AI & Large Language Models (LLMs)
Natural Language Processing (NLP)
Machine Learning
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Prompt Engineering & Model Fine-Tuning
Flask & FastAPI
RESTful API Development
Pandas & SQL
Semantic Search, Embeddings & Text Classification




Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and NLP-powered applications.
Build intelligent solutions for semantic search, chat assistants, recommendations, and content generation.
Develop NLP models for intent classification, entity extraction, summarization, and automated content creation.
Design and maintain RESTful APIs using Flask and FastAPI.
Analyze large-scale eCommerce datasets to improve customer experience and business outcomes.
Implement model monitoring, validation, observability, and performance optimization.
Perform data preprocessing, cleaning, and feature engineering using Python.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, UI/UX, Content, and Marketing teams to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, and governance standards.
Create technical documentation and support knowledge transfer.



Qualification: Bachelor's Degree (Mandatory)




Immediate Joiners are highly preferred. Interested candidates can share their updated resume at: Mishra.Neha@net2source.co.in
